credit_use_one_source.name: credit_use_one_source
credit_use_one_source.value:
("credit_use"."client_package_id" is not null and "credit_use"."wallet_lot_id" is null and "credit_use"."sessions" = 1 and "credit_use"."amount_paise" = 0)
      or ("credit_use"."wallet_lot_id" is not null and "credit_use"."client_package_id" is null and "credit_use"."sessions" = 0 and "credit_use"."amount_paise" > 0)

date_override_times.name: date_override_times
date_override_times.value: ("date_override"."start_time" is null and "date_override"."end_time" is null) or ("date_override"."start_time" < "date_override"."end_time")
